📢 Applications Invited | Legal Internship (Hybrid Mode) | Patna High Court

Advocate Anshuman Singh, practicing before the Patna High Court, invites applications for a Legal Internship (Hybrid Mode).

The practice encompasses a diverse range of matters, including:
• Civil Law
• Criminal Law
• Corporate Law
• Matrimonial & Family Law
• Labour Law
• Domestic Violence Matters
• Human Rights
• Property & Land Disputes

Roles & Responsibilities:
• Conduct legal research.
• Assist in drafting petitions, applications and legal briefs.
• Prepare case summaries and legal notes.
• Observe proceedings before the Patna High Court and other courts in Patna.
• Analyse case files shared electronically and present your understanding during discussions.

Mode: Hybrid

This internship is structured to provide flexibility. Regular attendance at the chamber is not mandatory. Interns may work remotely on research and drafting assignments, with periodic chamber visits (typically once a week) or virtual interactions, depending on the requirements of the work and mutual convenience.

Eligibility:
• Students in the 3rd year onwards of a 5-year LL.B. programme, or
• Students in the 2nd year onwards of a 3-year LL.B. programme.

Duration:
4–8 weeks (flexible), depending upon mutual convenience and academic schedules.

The internship is intended to provide meaningful exposure to litigation, with a strong emphasis on legal research, drafting, case analysis, courtroom observation and professional mentorship.

How to Apply:
Interested candidates may send their CV along with a brief cover email to anshuman.sngh@gmail.com.

We welcome applications from sincere, motivated and curious law students who are eager to learn the practical aspects of litigation and develop strong legal research and drafting skills.
